sloka: वज्रमुत्सृज्य वृत्राय भ्रान्ते ऽथ त्रिदिवेश्वरे ।शतं वर्षसहस्राणि येनेन्द्रत्वं प्रशासितम् ।। ७.५६.२८ ॥
transliteration: vajramutsṛjya vṛtrāya bhrānte 'tha tridiveśvare ।śataṁ varṣasahasrāṇi yenendratvaṁ praśāsitam ।। 7.56.28 ॥

translations.english: This refers to the one who ruled as Indra for a hundred thousand years when the actual Indra was agitated after casting his thunderbolt at Vritra.
